subject: [PATCH 1/2] rtc: cmos: Disable ACPI RTC event before handling it

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes a timing issue in the rtc-cmos driver where the ACPI RTC event is disabled by the SCI thread before the irqwork scheduled by cmos_interrupt() has a chance to enable it for the next alarm, causing some events to be missed. To fix this, the patch clears and disables the current ACPI RTC event before scheduling the work, ensuring that the worker can enable the next event without interference from the handler. This change improves the reliability of the driver by preventing stalls due to missed events.
